# runpod_endpoint_releases (Data Source)

Configuration releases of a Serverless endpoint and the state of the current rollout. Each release records what changed from the one before it.

**If you are an AI agent:** set up through https://agents.runpod.io first, then follow
[Using the provider from an AI agent](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/agent-setup) before you plan or apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_endpoint_releases" "vllm" {
  endpoint_id = "ep_abc123"
}

output "rollout_in_progress" {
  description = "Whether any worker still runs an older version."
  value       = data.runpod_endpoint_releases.vllm.rollout.in_progress
}

output "latest_release_changes" {
  description = "Configuration fields the newest release changed."
  value       = [for d in data.runpod_endpoint_releases.vllm.releases[0].diff : d.field]
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
[use-case modules](https://github.com/runpod/terraform-provider-runpod/tree/main/v2/modules);
the Guides section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_id` (String) Serverless endpoint identifier.

### Read-Only

- `endpoint_version` (Number) The endpoint's current configuration version.
- `releases` (Attributes List) One entry per release. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--releases))
- `rollout` (Attributes) How far the current version has reached the endpoint's workers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rollout))

<a id="nestedatt--releases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `releases`

Read-Only:

- `build_id` (String) Build the release deployed; null for a MANUAL release.
- `created_at` (String) Release timestamp in RFC 3339 format.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) Account user who created the release.
- `diff` (Attributes List) Configuration fields this release changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--releases--diff))
- `id` (String) Release identifier.
- `source` (String) What created the release: GIT_BUILD or MANUAL.
- `version` (Number) Configuration version this release produced.
- `worker_count` (Number) Workers currently running this release.

<a id="nestedatt--releases--diff"></a>
### Nested Schema for `releases.diff`

Read-Only:

- `field` (String) The changed field, top-level (e.g. gpuCount) or template-scoped (e.g. template.imageName).
- `new` (String) New value as JSON text; null when the field was removed.
- `old` (String) Previous value as JSON text; null when the field was added.



<a id="nestedatt--rollout"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rollout`

Read-Only:

- `in_progress` (Boolean) Whether any worker still runs an older version.
- `percent_on_latest` (Number) Percentage of workers on the current version; 0 when the endpoint has no workers.
- `workers_on_latest` (Number) Workers running the current version.
- `workers_total` (Number) All workers allocated to the endpoint.
